title: Burn subs.
subtitle: Drop an MKV and an ASS file — MoeKoder hardburns them with the GPU while the pot whistles. No preview noise. No pop-ups.
heading: Ready when you are.
body: Pick a video, a subtitle file, and a save location in the left rail — or drop them on the window and MoeKoder will line them up. Nothing leaves your machine, no preview popups.
ready: all three · ready · press begin in the rail
